feed.title: Undertow · Quirks
feed.subtitle: Attribute-bearing elements that WordPress/Blogger/plain-Atom generators emit

entry.title: Quirky Title With Type Attribute
entry.content: WordPress and Blogger emit type= on Atom <title>, which unmarshals to a map instead of a string.

entry.title: Bare Content With No Type Attribute
entry.content: Plain text content with no type attribute at all, which is valid Atom (type defaults to text) but unmarshals to a bare string instead of a map.
